responsibility: Specifies the ISO user-exception facility for gm2, defining abstract exception sources, exception numbers, and operations to allocate a source, raise an exception with an associated message, and query the current exceptional execution state. It is the public exception API consumed by library modules that define their own exception families and by handlers that inspect current source, number, and text.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public ISO definition module: it declares the abstract ExceptionSource type and the exception API signatures, but does not expose the runtime-backed representation or implementation details found in EXCEPTIONS.mod.
